answer: Require each identity to escrow a 680-unit bond and serve a thirty-three epoch probation. Each round it completes one random task and gathers four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for fourteen rounds. The ledger verifies signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm locks 680 units per alias and replays thirty-three rounds, while juniper markers track provenance, cipher hashes catch reused proofs, and signal rotation keeps tasks unpredictable.
